info.title: The Great Fair (HaYarid HaGadol) API
info.description:
Backend for a fair simulation game. 1 game day = 1 real hour.

**How to try it:** call POST /api/auth/login (or register), copy the `token`, click **Authorize** and paste it.

All money values are integer rubles. Errors look like `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }`.

balance.description: Rubles (may be negative after stall fees)

amount.description: Positive = money in, negative = money out
